observed.value: Three principal floors plus a gabled roof/attic register; do not create six stacked facade floors from the OSM building:levels=6 tag.
Five road-facing triangular gables: one large central gable with three pointed main openings and a small high triple-lancet vent; four smaller flanking gables with paired pointed openings.
Dark grey steep sloping main roof behind five front gables. A long upper ridge and uneven rear/annex structures are visible; this one image does not define the full rear roof plan.
Ground arches semicircular; second principal floor segmental arch heads; third principal floor rectangular straight heads; roof openings pointed Gothic arches.
Central ground triple-arch loggia/porch with round freestanding columns and visible deep dark recesses. Preserve physical column/arch depth rather than draw three dark rectangles.
